meta.title: Car-Go! — moving and transport services in Lisbon
meta.description: Full-service home and office moves in Lisbon and throughout Portugal: packing, furniture assembly, delivery help. Transparent pricing, free estimate.

hero.title: Your stress-free move starts with us
hero.subtitle: We arrive, pack, disassemble, transport and put everything back together. Apartments, offices and shops — in Lisbon and throughout Portugal.

price.title: What the price includes
price.note: The type of van does not affect the price: small or large, the rate is the same. The exact figure comes after the free estimate.

services.title: Services
services.homeText: Turnkey: packing, stretch wrap, furniture disassembly and assembly.
services.officeText: Moving outside business hours, with no downtime.
services.deliveryText: IKEA, AKI, Conforama, Makro, OLX — we collect, deliver and carry it in.
services.loadingText: Crew and equipment when the transport is already yours.
services.assemblyText: Assembly of any complexity and minor repairs at the new place.
services.customText: Describe it — we will calculate and name the price before we start.

cta.title: We will quote your move for free
cta.text: At a day and time that suits you, with no obligation. We reply within an hour.
